about: Sounding-rocket and balloon flights with public pointing, read from the FITS headers of each flight's data (XCEN, YCEN, NAXIS x CDELT, CROTA2, first and last DATE_OBS). Fields are in helioprojective arcsec as seen from Earth; roll in degrees counter-clockwise. A flight with several fixed pointings has one entry per pointing. Flights whose pointing is published only for the payload pointing system, or only in figures, are not listed.

flights.source: Hi-C 4K Level 1.5 v2 (field) and 1K Level 1.5 (time range), MSFC VSO
